result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 1 (code enforcement), covering administrative enforcement hearings, appeals, and administrative abatement procedures (§§ 12.0402-12.0603).
result.notes: This part contains only general code-enforcement hearing, appeal and nuisance-abatement procedures. Despite the source URL referencing San Diego's ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices (§ 98.1103), the text of that provision is not included in this part. No rule in the six in-scope categories (rent increase limits, just cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions, algorithmic rent setting) is stated here, so the list is empty.
